paragraphs.text:
The three of you remain under the overhang all night. At dawn, 
the sasquatches come and seize you by the arms. They drag 
you, and you alone, from camp. “Professor?” Norman sounds 
nervous. You warn him against impulsive moves, wishing you 
felt as confident as you sound.
